notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth patch 0.2.3.002 has been released!
notes.notes:
This patch contains the new game mode mini nuke plus a new map Arctic Outpost!  Full change log below:

Patch 0.2.3.002 Notes:

 New game mode Mini Nuke.  A nuke drops in the map and you have to grab the nuke before anyone else and take it to the base of the enemy and detonate it.  If a nuke is deployed at your base you have to disarm it before it detonates.
 New Map Arctic Outpost available for skirmish and mini nuke
 Sector 7 now has mini nuke gameplay mode available in Instant Action and Multiplayer.
 AI now knows how to play mini nuke gameplay.
 Number of respawns now defaults to 3 on all game modes.
 Fixed a few bugs with tree destruction so weapon interaction with trees works better now.
 You can drop the nuke by pressing N (default key)
 Foilage/Trees was updated on Sector 7.
 Updated the weather and lighting on sector7, The Octagon, Badlands Arena
 Enemy Base Marker now hides when the deploy marker is shown on mini-nuke once you pickup the nuke.
 indicator icons are more visible now and changed art a bit.
 Fixed an issue where AI could get stuck on a building on the defender side of sector 7.

notes.title: 🚀 Dev Update – Mini Nuke Game Mode Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while since our last update, so we wanted to share some exciting development news with you!

🔥 New Game Mode: Mini Nuke

We’ve been working hard on a brand-new gameplay mode called Mini Nuke. The core game type is now complete, and the AI is fully functional—but it’s still a bit buggy. We’re actively refining things and plan to release it to a larger group soon.

Before the full release, we’ll likely make it available on a pre-launch beta branch. If you’re interested in helping test it, this will be your chance to jump in early and share your feedback!

🧨 How It Works

In the first version of Mini Nuke, each team will have one deploy site.


 When the match begins, a nuke spawns in the center of the map with a visible indicator icon.
 A player can pick up the nuke by walking over it. The nuke is stored in their mech, and their indicator changes to show they’re carrying it.
 Their name and distance indicator remain red or green, so teammates and enemies can still identify them at a glance.
 The player carrying the nuke will also see a HUD icon above their weapons display indicating the nuke is equipped.
 A new deploy indicator will appear, pointing to the enemy’s deploy pad.


💣 Deploying & Disarming the Nuke


 Walk over the enemy deploy pad with the nuke to arm it.
 A detonation countdown will appear at the top of everyone's HUD.
 Your team must defend the nuke, while the enemy team tries to disarm it.


To disarm the nuke:


 Walk onto the deploy site and stand still.
 A "Disarm" message will appear below the countdown.
 Stay on the pad until both messages disappear — this means the nuke has been disarmed and picked up by your team.
 Now you can carry the nuke and attempt a deployment at the enemy base.


If the nuke carrier is destroyed, the nuke is dropped and can be picked up by anyone.

🎯 Win Conditions

You can win the match in one of two ways:


 Successfully deploy the nuke at the enemy base, triggering a nuclear explosion.
 Eliminate the entire enemy team.


To emphasize the objective, the default number of respawns is now set to 3.

🤖 Play Solo or Online

This mode is fully playable in:


 Instant Action vs. AI
 Multiplayer vs. players or a mix of players and AI


📣 Beta Branch & Feedback

We’ll post another announcement when Mini Nuke hits the beta branch. We’d love to hear your thoughts — on the mode itself, on balance, and especially on the AI, which now has a lot of new functionality to support this gameplay.

Thanks for your continued support! We’re excited to get this mode into your hands soon.

— X10 Game Studios

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth Hotfix 0.2.2.005 is released!
notes.notes: The hotfix patch 0.2.2.005 has been released.  This patch addresses some issues seen yesterday in multiplayer with credits not being recorded and various networking issues.  If you still experience the same problems and this patch did not fix them please let us know on the forums or on discord.

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth Demo updated to version 0.2.2.004!
notes.notes:
The final update before the full release of the game is now available.  The Demo has been updated to 0.2.2.004 which will be the full release version tomorrow March 11th.

Change log for 0.2.2.004:

 Updated the main menu music to a different track.
 Updated in game score teams UI.
 You now get feed back on login failure and calls to the servers can now retry up to 3 times if a call fails to prevent you from losing credits or XP.  Valid Login is now required to play.
 You can no longer edit default stock MCs.
 Changed text references of Configuration to MC.
 Fix for a bug where projectiles could stop working correctly on test range
 Fixed lots of issues that show up in the logs.
 Removed continue button for the clients on end game screen and replaced with Waiting for Host text since host moves everyone back to lobby.

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth Demo updated to version 0.2.2.003!
notes.notes:
As we ramp up for the release of Mechanized Corps: Rebirth on March 11th, we have released patch 0.2.2.003. This release has significant changes to the AI as well as some bug fixes.  Full change log below.

Change log

 Upgraded AI system to a newer version of our internal system to allow for adding new AI features easier.
 Upgraded AI to perform better at a basic level.
 Updating home target to be slightly above cockpit and reduced size of rocket explosions to cut down on homing rockets blinding you in first person mode.
 Added a photo sensitivity warning since it can get intense being shot in cockpit mode.
 Removed reference to steam cloud in save text since we no longer use it.
 Fixed a pathing issue where AI could get stuck sometimes on the door going out of spawn bays on non sector 7 maps.
 Added extra AI bot pilots and squads.
 Fixed a bug where if you self destructed more than once before exploding it would count it as multiple deaths.
 Fixed issue where AI would stop sometimes.
 Updated AI to use Countermeasures if they have them equipped.
 Fixed an issue where spectator cam would clip on the mech it's following.
